Method: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost with SMOTE
Key_Finding: BTC volatility is the #1 predictor of stablecoin depegging. Sentiment indicators showed NO significant predictive power.
Critical_Limitation: Daily frequency misses intraday crashes. Random train/test split causes data leakage. No on-chain transaction data. Excluded algorithmic stablecoins (UST).
Our_Project_Addresses: Hourly prediction granularity. Chronological purged splits. On-chain wallet flow features from SNAP dataset. Includes UST.

Method: Cross-sectional OLS regression (Event Study) with ELV framework
Stablecoins: 18 stablecoins including UST, USDC, DAI, USDT
Key_Finding: Fair value (ELV) based on reserve quality explains 94% of run pressure variation (R²=0.939). Crypto-collateralized coins faced more run pressure.
Critical_Limitation: Pure post-mortem analysis. Cannot predict in real-time. N=18 cross-sectional observations, not time-series. No deployable prediction model.
Our_Project_Addresses: Dynamic time-series prediction at hourly intervals. Forward-looking target variable Y(t+h). Deployable ML pipeline.

Method: Panel regression with transaction velocity metrics
Key_Finding: Transaction velocity is the strongest driver of devaluation severity.
Critical_Limitation: Explains devaluation severity, not onset timing. No classification model for early warning.
Our_Project_Addresses: Adapted velocity metrics as input features. Classification framework for onset prediction.

Method: Panel Cauchit model with $0.80 price threshold
Key_Finding: Lagged market cap and historical volatility are strongest predictors of stablecoin failure.
Critical_Limitation: $0.80 threshold too extreme for early warning — coin is already dead at 80 cents. Daily frequency.
Our_Project_Addresses: 1% threshold captures early stress. Hourly granularity for actionable alerts.
